headlineOfDay: Wall Street rebounds sharply as oil slides on Trump's Iran de-escalation, even as Nvidia's CEO scandal deepens and Abu Dhabi hosts Ukraine talks.

markets.summary: US stocks rebounded strongly, with the S&P 500 up 2.35% and the Nasdaq up 2.74%, after last week's sell-off. A sharp fall in oil prices on Trump's signals of restraint on Iran lifted sentiment, while chip stocks such as AMD rallied even as Nvidia fell. European and Gulf markets also rose, with the FTSE 100 up 1.02%.

gainers.name: Advanced Micro Devices
gainers.note: Rose sharply, with analysts noting it as a possible beneficiary of the Nvidia scandal.

losers.name: Nvidia
losers.note: Fell after its board opened an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with a suspected Chinese spy.

stories.headline: Nvidia drops as board investigates CEO Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy
